description: VodBox-pinned emulation engine for the ARM64 backend JNI bridge. Replaces the opaque upstream unidbg-unicorn2:0.9.8 prebuilt natives.

engine.role: Unicorn2 fork providing the static libunicorn.a the JNI bridge links against
engine.commit_source: Branch 'unicorn2' HEAD of zhkl0228/unicorn as observed via the GitHub API (branches/unicorn2 -> 548eda46...). This is the Unicorn2 line (include/unicorn/uc_ctl-style control API + platform.h CPU-model enums), NOT the Unicorn1 master line. The pinned sha is a specific immutable commit object; the branch ref itself may advance but the recorded sha does not.
engine.tag_note: zhkl0228/unicorn publishes only 1.0.x / 0.9 tags (Unicorn1 line). The Unicorn2 branch carries no release tag, so the pin is by commit sha, not by tag. Any '1.0.14'-style version label applies to the Unicorn1 line only and MUST NOT be used to name this engine.

api_evidence.why_this_commit: The bridge C source (unicorn.c) calls uc_ctl_set_cpu_model and uc_ctl_remove_cache and references UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX / UC_CPU_ARM_CORTEX_A15. Those symbols exist ONLY in the Unicorn2 line. Verified present at this commit, from the fetched tree:
api_evidence.topology_proof: include/unicorn/ contains platform.h, arm.h, arm64.h, s390x.h, tricore.h and unicorn.h with a uc_ctl family; tree root has CMakeLists.txt. This is the Unicorn2 layout. (The prior Unicorn1 pin's tree instead had qemu/target-arm/unicorn.h, include/qemu.h and bindings/ruby, and none of the four symbols.)

engine.build_command_source: Engine CMakeLists.txt at this commit, read not guessed: line 1175 'add_library(unicorn ${UNICORN_SRCS})' is a STATIC lib by default (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF); line 61 'set(UNICORN_ARCH "x86;arm;aarch64;..." CACHE STRING ...)'. NOTE: the retained upstream linux/windows build-script header comment ('UNICORN_ARCHS="arm aarch64" UNICORN_STATIC=yes ./make.sh') is a STALE copy-paste from Unicorn1; this Unicorn2 tree has no make.sh/Makefile — it is CMake-only. The upstream scripts' actual link lines confirm CMake output: they link $UNICORN_HOME/build/libunicorn.a.
engine.produces: build/libunicorn.a (Linux/Darwin, CMake single-config archive in the build/ dir). Windows/MinGW: build/unicorn.a (MinGW drops the lib prefix).
engine.products_path_note: These are CMake output paths under build/. The prior pin documented 'no build/ subdir' — true for Unicorn1 make.sh, FALSE for this Unicorn2 CMake tree.
engine.license_note: UNIDBG_BRIDGE_LICENSE must not be assumed to cover the engine. The bridge is Apache-2.0 (unidbg); the engine is GPL-2.0. Recorded, not elected. (License classification unchanged by the Unicorn1->Unicorn2 pin correction; re-confirm at vendor-notice time.)

bridge.source_commit_note: unidbg v0.9.8 release commit; bridge ships as source in the release tree so matching it verbatim is faithful, unlike the engine which does not.

not_claimed: That any rebuilt library byte-matches the upstream prebuilt natives/*/libunicorn.* in unidbg-unicorn2:0.9.8.

That the upstream engine commit equals this pin; the upstream commit is unrecoverable from public evidence. A successful build proves the pin is API-COMPLETE for the bridge, not that it is the publisher's exact revision.
That this is a retroactive proof of the old publisher's provenance.

That pinning the unicorn2 branch HEAD matches the exact tree the upstream 0.9.8 prebuilts were produced from; the branch HEAD is the best public Unicorn2 revision, selected because it is the only public tree carrying the four bridge-required Control-API symbols.

pin_correction.reason: 15cad005 is the Unicorn1 line (tagged 1.0.14). Its tree provides include/unicorn/unicorn.h but NONE of uc_ctl_set_cpu_model, uc_ctl_remove_cache, UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX, UC_CPU_ARM_CORTEX_A15. The bridge unicorn.c requires all of these, so linking the bridge against 15cad005 fails at compile/link. Corrected to the unicorn2 branch HEAD commit 548eda46, which provides them.
pin_correction.detection: Reported by the main agent after the static-library link surfaced missing uc_ctl_set_cpu_model / uc_ctl_remove_cache / UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX / UC_CPU_ARM_CORTEX_A15; confirmed here by inspecting both trees' include/unicorn/ headers.
pin_correction.evidence_source_note: The previous 'commit_source' cited that 15cad005 was 'byte-matched in dependency-sources/native-manifest as the zhkl0228/unicorn:1.0.14 engine archive'. That established the OLD PUBLISHER SHIPPED a 1.0.14 Unicorn1 archive under some tag — it does NOT establish the old prebuilt libunicorn.so was built from 15cad005. A new/rebuilt binary being API-compatible with the bridge is the only claim made here.
